fields.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
fields.staySignedInHint: Only on your own phone or computer.
fields.keepSignedIn: Keep me signed in on this computer for 30 days
fields.trustComputerHint: Only on a computer you alone use. You won't be asked for a code here again.

validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number, for example 077 123 4567.
validation.identifierRequired: Enter your phone number or email address.
validation.passwordTooLong: That password is too long. Check it and try again.
validation.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.

errors.invalidCredentials: {who, select, staff {The phone, email or password is wrong.} other {The phone number or password is wrong.}} Check them and try again.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is turned off. Please contact your institute.
errors.accountLocked: This account is locked after too many wrong passwords. <link>Unlock it with an SMS code</link>.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.tenantUnavailable: This institute's account is not available right now, so you can't log in. Please contact your institute.
errors.deviceLimit: You're already signed in on 2 devices. Log out on one of them, or ask your institute to sign them out, then try again.
errors.twoStepNoPhone: Your account needs a mobile number for the sign-in code. Ask the institute owner to add it.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new code.
errors.ticketExpired: That took too long, so we stopped for your safety. Start again.
errors.commonPassword: That password is too common. Choose one that is harder to guess.
errors.network: We couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your phone number. If it has an account here, we'll text you a 6-digit code.

first.title: Set your password
first.intro: Your institute added you. Enter your phone number and we'll text you a 6-digit code to set your password.

unlock.title: Unlock your account
unlock.intro: Enter your phone number. If the account is locked, we'll text you a 6-digit code to unlock it.

code.sentTo: If {phone} has an account here, we sent a 6-digit code to it. It works for 10 minutes.
code.doneBody: You can log in with your new password now. Any device that was signed in has been signed out.
code.unlockedBody: You can log in again with your password.

deviceLimit.title: You're signed in on 2 devices
deviceLimit.body: Your account works on 2 devices at a time. Sign out of one to use this device.
deviceLimit.why: The 2-device rule stops accounts being shared, which protects your teacher's lessons.
deviceLimit.chooseDevice: Choose a device to sign out.
deviceLimit.continue: Sign out this device and continue
deviceLimit.changed: Your devices changed meanwhile. Log in again to see the current list.

twoStep.title: Check your phone
twoStep.body: Owner, admin and cashier accounts need a code. We sent it to {phone}.

invite.title: Join {institute}
invite.intro: {name}, you've been invited as {role}. Choose a password to finish.
invite.invalidBody: It may have expired, been used already or been cancelled. Ask the institute owner to send a new one.
invite.conflict: This phone number or email already has an account here. Ask the institute owner to check the invitation.
